0022600159.text: The Pistons (4-1, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) are on a one-game winning streak and have gone 2-1 on the road, while the Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast and 5th in the East) dropped their last game. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 97-89 win in Detroit on October 28, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
